name: DeFi Plaza (DefiPlaza V2 DEX, Ethereum)
race_type_reason: Yoink's tx (block 20240539, position 0) makes the same 25 DeFi Plaza calls with identical calldata and ETH values as the attacker's own deploy+run() replayed on a fork; the attacker's run() was still pending and only landed one block later (reverted on the drained pool).
one_liner: Yoink drained DeFi Plaza (~$217K) at block 20240539 position 0, replaying the attacker's pending deploy+run() pair; the attacker's run() reverted a block later. Yoink bribed 66.3 ETH; only ~$23K of tokens came back, no ETH.

attack_txs.role: deploy attack contract (landed at position 3 of Yoink's block, after Yoink's tx at position 0)
run() on the new contract; pending when Yoink's block was built, reverted on the already-drained pool

bots_other.label: second EOA, byte-identical deployment (unproven relation to attacker)
bots_other.role: deployed identical initcode 1201 ms before the attacker's deploy was first seen; the contract was never called

bots_other.label: Yoink second tx in the same block
bots_other.role: second Yoink tx at position 11 (coinbase 0.9463 ETH); not part of this race, not analysed

mempool_note: mempool-dumpster (local, bloxroute, chainbound, mempoolguru) first saw the attacker deploy and run() together at 13:15:29.185 UTC, 5,815 ms before the slot start; Yoink's tx never appears in the public mempool. A lower-fee replacement pair was seen 604 ms later and never mined.

trigger.note: Deploy tx 0x8f029510 (nonce 12) and run() tx 0xe00b0998 (nonce 13) were first seen at the same millisecond. A second EOA 0x907f8529 broadcast a byte-identical deployment 1201 ms earlier (13:15:27.984, tx 0xbb5dffb0, landed block 20240540 position 219, never called); its link to the attacker is unproven.

attacker_block_note: The attacker's run() 0xe00b0998 landed one block after Yoink's block (20240540, position 27) and reverted on the drained pool; its deploy 0x8f029510 landed in Yoink's block at position 3.

loot.gross_loot_method: net outflow of 15 ERC-20s plus 4.546 ETH from pool 0xe68c1d72 in the Yoink tx (research/defiplaza-ronin/defiplaza_plaza_net_flows.json) = $216,831 at DefiLlama 13:15 prices, divided by ETH price 2954.6

captured_native.amount: 13,504.30 USDT, 0.24367467 WBTC, 13,409.07 USDC, 13,413.80 DAI, 257,253.14 DFP2, 121,266.68 eXRD swept to vault, plus ETH proceeds that paid the bribe
captured_native.desc: Yoink swapped the drained tokens to ETH inside the tx, paid a fixed 66.318 ETH to the coinbase, and swept 6 assets to its vault EOA 0xc70f00cd.

loot.captured_usd_source: pool net outflow in the Yoink tx at DefiLlama prices 13:15:35 UTC (this equals the protocol loss; the bot's own net is bot_net_eth)
loot.loot_note: bot_net_eth is a tx-level estimate: change in the bot contract's ETH balance during the tx (-18.129 ETH, net of all ETH legs including flash-loan-funded ones: the 66.318 ETH coinbase payment exceeded the ETH the swaps returned, so part of the bribe came from ETH the contract already held) + the 6 swept assets valued at DefiLlama 13:15 prices (21.151 ETH, $62,493) + the 4.761 ETH builder refund; before flash-loan fees and before any later return. builder_payout_to_victim_eth is null: the 62.541 ETH the builder passed on went to the Lido Execution Layer Rewards Vault (the proposer), not to DeFi Plaza. The 62.541 ETH is the proposer payment, see fate.

fate.returned_desc: After DeFi Plaza sent an on-chain message to Yoink's owner EOA (tx 0x1e34998e, 2024-07-05T19:00:23Z), the vault returned 600.34 USDC, 13,413.80 DAI, 257,253.14 DFP2 and 121,266.68 eXRD in four txs between 19:42 and 19:47 UTC (about $22.7K, ~7.7 ETH-equivalent). USDT, WBTC and most of the USDC had already been sold (~13.4 ETH per incident.json, not independently re-priced). No ETH was returned on chain. The 62.541 ETH paid to the proposer (Lido vault) never passed through the bot.

returned_txs.note: 600.336633 USDC from vault 0xc70f00cd to DeFi Plaza deployer 0x0422afb5 (ETH-equivalent at DefiLlama 13:15 prices)
13,413.796570 DAI from vault 0xc70f00cd to DeFi Plaza deployer 0x0422afb5 (ETH-equivalent at DefiLlama 13:15 prices)
257,253.140376 DFP2 from vault 0xc70f00cd to DeFi Plaza deployer 0x0422afb5 (ETH-equivalent at DefiLlama 13:15 prices)
121,266.679431 eXRD from vault 0xc70f00cd to DeFi Plaza deployer 0x0422afb5 (ETH-equivalent at DefiLlama 13:15 prices)
on-chain message from the DeFi Plaza deployer to Yoink's owner EOA (not a return)

fate.public_statement: Lido research forum (DeFi Plaza RFC, 2024-08-31): 'We have contacted the front runner and they promptly returned their profits from the transaction to the DefiPlaza team.' The on-chain returns are the four token transfers above; no ETH return is visible.
fate.return_status_rule: returned = everything went back to the victim side except a bounty the victim agreed to or offered; partial = some came back, otherwise; none = known zero within the documented search window; unknown = unresolved

discrepancies: kept_by_bot_eth (0.104) is the tx-level net minus the token return, i.e. roughly break-even within valuation error: most of the 66.3 ETH bribe was paid out of the tokens it sold or kept in its own ETH balance. Do not read it as bot profit.
incident.json captured.usd = 62,493 is only the 6 swept assets; this row's captured_usd is the whole pool outflow (216,831) and loot.bot_net_eth is the tx-level net.
evidence_notes: Fork replay of the attacker's own deploy+run() on a local anvil fork of block 20240538: the 25 DeFi Plaza state-changing calls match Yoink's 25 byte for byte (calldata, selectors, ETH values); only msg.sender differs (research/defiplaza-ronin/defiplaza_fork_replay.json, defiplaza_plaza_calls.json).
Block 20240539: Yoink tx at position 0, attacker deploy at position 3; the attacker's run() reverted in 20240540 at position 27 (incidents/defiplaza-2024/race_20240539.json, race_20240540.json).

Attacker deploy+run() first seen 13:15:29.185 UTC (4 mempool sources), 5.8 s before the slot; Yoink's builder 'I can haz block?' bid 3.0 s later and won at 62.5409 ETH over the best rival 62.4928 ETH; Yoink's tx was never in the public mempool.
Fixed bribe 66.318 ETH to the coinbase; builder paid 62.541 ETH to the Lido vault and refunded 4.761 ETH to the bot contract (block position 12).
Second EOA 0x907f8529 deployed byte-identical initcode 1,201 ms before the attacker's deploy was first seen (tx 0xbb5dffb0, block 20240540 position 219); relation unproven.
